name: concurrency
prompt: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/?scenario=concurrency and extract the title and date for all 50 document items. Process the detail pages in parallel using 4 concurrent browser tabs. Save each item to save_record with the source URL.

description: 50+ items requiring parallel processing. Run config sets parallel_runners: 4. Tests asyncio.Queue, gate_lock, per-tab workers.
